title: Upper Density Theorem for μHE[n] and a finite-measure Borel set (Simon Ch. 1, 3.3 and 3.6)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set with H^n(S) < ∞, where H^n = μHE[n]. Then for H^n-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P: if x ∉ S, then H^n(S ∩ closedBall(x, ρ)) / ρ^n → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (the quotient taken in [0, ∞], with ρ^n = ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)^n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet S → μHE[n] S ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∉ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
